purpose: Exploratory physical Pi 3B+ Release kernel and userspace timings; not a calibrated regression verdict

method.statistic: median of retained batch elapsed_ns / iterations
method.clock: kernel monotonic Generic Timer; elapsed wall time includes scheduling and waiting
method.timed_overhead: probe loop, workload string selection, return-value checks; no empty-loop subtraction
method.untimed: serial output, batch topinfo snapshots, setup, batch data comparisons and teardown
method.switches: system-wide batch context-switch delta, not task-exclusive
limitations: two full runs in one boot, not cold-boot repetitions
file workloads use RAM files, not SD
file service native protocol not measured

artifacts.probe_rebuild_verification: After comment correction, rebuilt ELF is byte-identical to measured probe

experiments.name: idle_masked_wfi
experiments.hypothesis: The unmask-before-WFI window is sufficient to explain the cross-core latency
experiments.source_patch:
--- baseline/arch.cppm
+++ idle-masked/arch.cppm
@@ -143,13 +143,13 @@
 // (used by scheduler idle tasks)
 inline void cpu_idle_once() noexcept {
 #if defined(MOSS_ARCH_ARM64)
-  // Match x64 (sti;hlt;cli) and RISC-V 64 (csrsi;wfi;csrci) pattern:
-  // enable IRQ → WFI → disable IRQ.
-  // Enable IRQ delivery so wakeups can run their handlers; keep the caller's
-  // scheduler bookkeeping after this sequence protected by masking again.
+  // Diagnostic variant: test whether servicing and clearing a wakeup before
+  // WFI loses the runqueue notification. ARM WFI wakes on a pending physical
+  // IRQ even with DAIF.I set; unmask only after returning from the wait.
+  asm volatile("msr daifset, #0x2" ::: "memory"); // DAIF.I masks IRQ delivery, not WFI wakeup.
   asm volatile("dsb sy" ::: "memory");
-  asm volatile("msr daifclr, #0x2" ::: "memory"); // enable IRQ (clear DAIF.I)
   asm volatile("wfi" ::: "memory");
+  asm volatile("msr daifclr, #0x2; isb" ::: "memory"); // Deliver the pending wakeup before bookkeeping.
   asm volatile("msr daifset, #0x2" ::: "memory"); // disable IRQ (set DAIF.I)
   asm volatile("isb" ::: "memory");
 #elif defined(MOSS_ARCH_X64)

failed_attempt.error: Invalid ACK (7) in DAP response; dump_image at 0x200c0000 returned -107
failed_attempt.classification: transport failure, not a kernel runtime result

experiments.conclusion: No material cross-core improvement: changing this sequence alone did not remove the roughly 3.77 ms latency. Exact scheduling/wakeup cause remains unresolved.

jtag_diagnostic.conclusion: All 36 halted observations were at idle WFI return PC; halted sampling perturbs execution and is not an unbiased CPU profile
